svg.title: Peer-to-peer energy trading
svg.desc: Peer-to-peer energy trading (Oorja · Beckn protocol). Built and deployed a platform where households trade rooftop solar directly, on India's Digital Energy Grid pilot. Showcased at the India AI Impact Summit 2026. Order placement that cannot oversell under concurrent buyers: row-level locks inside a Redis lock Order matcher that fills across sellers ranked by price, trust and delivery window Reputation tiers that raise a seller's trade limit from 10% to 100% Settlement for partial delivery; seller capacity verified from signed credentials
